```{r data}
# Read the data
data <- read.csv("LOCAL PATH", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

# Clean column names (remove BOM if present)
colnames(data) <- gsub("^�", "", colnames(data))
str(data) #view data
```

```{r Category bar chart}

# Bar chart for Category (ordered by frequency, highest to lowest)

category_counts <- data %>%
  count(Category) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / nrow(data) * 100,
         Category = factor(Category, levels = Category))

ggplot(category_counts, aes(x = Category, y = percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.8) +  
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%", " (n=", n, ")")),  # Add count next to %
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Bioinformatics nf-core Pipeline Categories",  
       y = "Percentage (%)") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())  # Remove x-axis title

category_counts

```

```{r Sub-Categories table}

# Table for Sub-Categories (renamed from Unlinked_Sub-Categories) - excluding blanks and counts < 2
subcat_counts <- data %>%
  rename_with(~ "Sub-Categories", matches("Unlinked")) %>%
  filter(`Sub-Categories` != "" & !is.na(`Sub-Categories`)) %>%  # Remove blank and NA values
  count(`Sub-Categories`) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / nrow(data) * 100) %>%  # Calculate percentage based on original dataset
  filter(n >= 2)  # Remove rows where count is n < 2

# Create and display the table
subcat_table <- subcat_counts %>%
  select(`Sub-Categories`, Count = n, Percentage = percentage) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))  # Ensure it's sorted by count (highest to lowest)

# Format the percentage column for better readability
subcat_table_formatted <- subcat_table %>%
  mutate(Percentage = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%"))

print(subcat_table_formatted)

```
